sols=[]
def search(covered, used, chosen):
    if len(used)==len(pieces):
      if covered==mask: sols.append(chosen[:])
      return
    # pick uncovered cell with fewest compatible candidates
    unc=mask-covered
    best=None; opts_best=None
    for cell in unc:
      opts=[p for p in allp if p[0] not in used and cell in p[3] and not (p[3]&covered)]
      if not opts: return
      if opts_best is None or len(opts)<len(opts_best): best,opts_best=cell,opts
      if len(opts_best)==1: break
    for p in opts_best:
      name=p[0]
      # duplicate color groups names unique yes
      search(covered|p[3],used|{name},chosen+[p])
